name: Model compatibility
about: Report a model, runtime, hardware, or browser result

Provide the exact model reference and revision, runtime version, browser build, operating system, hardware class, execution device, cold or warm state, and sanitized reproduction. Distinguish download, load, inference, output quality, cancellation, and offline behavior.

Never attach weights, credentials, private prompts, or proprietary evaluation data.
